start.prompt:
Create a production pixel-art illustration for an Optiq homepage learning card. The attached image is the EXISTING MASCOT REFERENCE. Preserve this exact character identity: a living upright magnifying-glass creature with a forest-green circular rim and short vertical handle on TOP like a stem, pale blue glass face, two simple black vertical pixel eyes, small forest-green feet and little green arms, heavy near-black stepped pixel outline, white square glint on the lens. Not a human, not a robot, not an animal. Keep the familiar round silhouette and green top stem. Use true chunky low-resolution pixel art, as if hand drawn on a 160x128 pixel canvas and enlarged nearest-neighbor: uniform visible square pixels, no smooth curves, no antialiasing, no gradients, no blur, no texture, no isometric perspective. Palette: forest green #365C49 and #40785C, pale blue #B8D9EB, off-white #F7F7F5, pale sage #E7EEE7, charcoal #171717, small muted coral #C46950 and mustard #D5B55A accents for picture content. Transparent background, do NOT copy the reference's off-white square background. No floor or backdrop. No words, letters, numbers, logos, captions, buttons or watermarks. Simple cohesive editorial sprite scene filling the image width, centered and bottom weighted, with generous transparent margins. The mascot must visibly be doing the action rather than merely standing beside unrelated props. All supporting text will be real HTML outside this image.

The mascot's blue face and top green stem remain clearly visible. The mascot and the photograph together fill most of the scene, no extra decorations.
